belongs_to: Section 5.1, page no. 108, Figure it out Q.4: "Is this figure somehow related to the 'idli-vada' game? Hint: Imagine playing the game till 30. description: Venn diagram of two equal-sized circles overlapping side by side (left circle and right circle, thin black outline, white inside, no shading, no outer universe box). Label above the left circle: "Multiple of 3" (bold, singular 'Multiple'). Label above the right circle: "Multiple of 5" (bold). The numbers are bold, written with commas and no spaces. LEFT-ONLY region (inside the Multiple-of-3 circle, outside the overlap) holds 16 numbers in 7 centred lines, top to bottom: "3,6,9,12" / "18,21" / "24,27" / "33,36" / "39,42" / "48,51,54" / "57" (4+2+2+2+2+3+1 = 16 numbers; these are the multiples of 3 up to 60 that are not multiples of 5). OVERLAP (lens) region holds 4 numbers in a column, one per line, in a slightly larger bold font: 15, 30, 45, 60. RIGHT-ONLY region (inside the Multiple-of-5 circle, outside the overlap) holds 8 numbers in 4 lines of two, in the larger font: "5,10" / "20,25" / "35,40" / "50,55" (the multiples of 5 up to 60 that are not multiples of 3). Nothing is outside the circles. Text of the left-circle lines 24,27 / 33,36 / 39,42 and 48,51,54 touches or slightly crosses the left edge of the overlap lens; no arrows, no counts, no title. Whole picture is centred on the page below the answer sentence.
